# Badread

## Role

Badread simulates error-prone long reads with user-controlled artifacts. It is
well suited for ONT stress tests and for bacterial plasmid behavior.

## Key Controls

- `--quantity`: bases or requested depth.
- `--length`: mean and SD of fragment lengths.
- `--identity`: identity or quality-score distribution.
- `--error_model`, `--qscore_model`: sequencing error behavior.
- `--chimeras`, `--junk_reads`, `--random_reads`, `--glitches`: artifacts.
- `--small_plasmid_bias`: underrepresentation of small circular plasmids.

## Guardrails

Badread's flexibility is a strength, not a claim that its defaults reproduce
every platform. Match parameters to a real target read set when realism matters.
